schema.note: Public map/Radar list stays ungated. depth.* (esp. founders[].linkedin, sources, researchNotes) can later require login without breaking entries that lack depth.

verification.fieldProvenance: Each depth claim should carry source URL when possible
verification.note: Data-first: run npm run radar:reconcile weekly before product gates

listSize.rationale: Depth re-verify capacity beats ambition; weak names destroy trust more than missing names.

gates: Verified Hyderabad substance (HQ / local R&D / manufacturing — not Inc42 mention alone)
Hard discovery signal: gem|zoho|keka|rippling|remote-india|us-hq-hyd-office|incubator|outskirts|alias trap. funding-list and marketing-careers are SUPPORTING only — never qualify alone or as a pair
Problem class: physical / scientific / regulated / infrastructure — hard-reject HRM, payroll, generic CRM, IT staffing, agency, me-too chatbot
Depth obtainable: at least two of founder LinkedIns, office nuance, alias, non-obvious careers, incubator pin — else map pin only
newAgeTests: Substitution: Zoho/agency/LLM wrapper in six months?
Hyderabad: would product change if Hyd team vanished?
acceptIf: Core: strong Hyd substance + defensibility; Watch: strong but evidence gap
Deep Roots allowed for serious Genome Valley / industrial R&D anchors
rejectIf: funding-list + marketing-careers with no harder signal
Famous corridor names (fame is disqualifying for Radar)
sectorPriority: Life sciences / Genome Valley / med-device / pharma-tech
AI only when applied to regulated or physical domains
B2B SaaS: max ~3 slots and only with Gem/Zoho/US-HQ quirk
